title: Venice 1823 San Lazzaro Lyturgia Armena: core Armenian Badarak Anaphora constituent — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Core Classical Armenian (Grabar) Anaphora of the Armenian Divine Liturgy (Badarak) from the priest's opening Trinitarian blessing rubric and greeting (Քահանայն դարձցի և խաչակնքեսցէ ✠ ՚ի վերայ ժողովրդեանն, և ասասցէ։ Շնորհք, սէր, և աստուածային սրբարար զօրութիւն...) at printed p. 46 (PDF p. 50) through the Preface, Sanctus incipit (p. 47 / PDF p. 51; excluding the intervening full-page Crucifixion engraving at unnumbered p. [48] / PDF p. 52 as non-text), Post-Sanctus and Institution Narrative (pp. [49]–50 / PDF pp. 53–54), Anamnesis and Oblation (pp. 51–52 / PDF pp. 55–56), and the complete Epiclesis (triple past-tense արարեր blessings, combined փոխարկելով blessing, rubric, and concluding ekphonesis Որպէս զի եղիցի սա... ՚ի թողութիւն մեղաց։) at printed p. 53 (PDF p. 57), immediately before the post-epiclesis general intercessions (Սովաւ շնորհեա՛ զսէր...). Uses the exact same 6 canonical native_path slugs as armenian-1642-badarak-anaphora for 1-to-1 collation.

pages.description: Front covers/flyleaves (PDF pp. 1–4), title page (printed PA1 / PDF p. 5), and pre-Anaphora service texts through printed p. 45 (PDF p. 49).
Printed p. 46: lower half from priest's Trinitarian blessing rubric (Քահանայն դարձցի...) through Դպիրքն։ Արժան և իրաւ։; upper-half Peace/Kiss of Peace/Proclamation dialogue is excluded.
Printed p. 47: complete Preface/Thanksgiving, Sanctus ekphonesis, and Sanctus incipit.

Unnumbered printed p. [48]: full-page copperplate Crucifixion engraving with a two-line devotional verse caption (Ո՜հ թէ որքան էր սաստկագին կսկիծ կուսին...) inserted between Sanctus and Post-Sanctus; non-liturgical pictorial plate.
Unnumbered printed p. [49] (signature 4): Post-Sanctus prayer and opening line of Bread Institution Narrative.
Printed p. 50: Bread and Chalice Institution Narratives and Post-Institution prayer (Եւ զսոյն...).
Printed p. 51: Anamnesis, Oblation, Յամենայնի incipit, and opening of Զքեզ արդարև.
Printed p. 52: completion of Զքեզ արդարև, Peace and pre-Epiclesis dialogue, and Epiclesis through opening line of combined bread-and-wine blessing.

Printed p. 53: upper portion completing the combined Epiclesis blessing, repetition rubric, and concluding ekphonesis (Որպէս զի եղիցի սա... ՚ի թողութիւն մեղաց։); post-Epiclesis intercessions beginning Եւ ապա տարածեալ զձեռս... Սովաւ շնորհեա՛... are excluded.

Post-Epiclesis intercessions, Diptychs (including p. 55 papal/hierarch rubric), Lord's Prayer, Communion, Gospel bodies (pp. 69–70), Dismissal (p. 71), Alleluia appendix (pp. 72–80, ending PDF p. 84), and endpapers (PDF pp. 85–88).
